infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: CourseCollab adds your class schedule to Apple Calendar and sends class reminders.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: CourseCollab adds your class schedule to Apple Calendar and sends class reminders.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: CourseCollab sends class reminders, quiz deadlines, announcements, and course messages.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: CourseCollab uses speech recognition for live captions in AI Notetaker and voice dictation in Cora.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CourseCollab needs microphone access for lecture recording in AI Notetaker and voice dictation in Cora.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CourseCollab uses the camera when you choose to capture and upload coursework or profile content.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CourseCollab needs photo access when you choose to upload coursework or profile content.

plugins.calendarPermission: CourseCollab adds your recurring class schedule to Apple Calendar.

plugins.photosPermission: CourseCollab needs photo access for assignment uploads.
plugins.cameraPermission: CourseCollab needs camera access for assignment photos.
